text:
maria: Heads-up — promo for release 2026.3.1 is blocked. Deploy bot paused the canary->stable promotion. Seeing two failures in the pipeline: artifact upload lease timeout and a Helm secret decryption error during the prehook. Anyone available?

deploy-bot: Promotion paused: canary -> stable for release=2026.3.1. Reason: artifact-upload-lease-timeout (job://ci/7824). See: https://ci.redwood/reports/7824 :warning:

samir: I can take a look. Quick question — is the registry upload failing (S3) or the internal artifact index?

andrew: Logs show repeated PUTs to s3 returning 409/lease-conflict, then a timeout. Also a Helm prehook job fails with: 
```
Error: failed to decrypt secret "release-credentials": ciphertext verification failed
exit status 1
```
So two distinct failures that coincided with the promo window.

jen: Ugh, we had a secret rotation earlier today for the helm KMS key. Could be related. Also CI token rotation happened this morning — maybe some runners still using old creds. :thinking_face:

kai: I can try reuploading the artifact from a runner with the new token, or we can pin to last-good image to unblock promotions. Which do we prefer?

maria: I think the least-impact path is temporary pin to last-good and unblock promo, then follow-up to repro the artifact upload + secret decrypt issue. Last-good image is gcr.redwood/release:2026.2.9 (digest sha256:abc123).

samir: Agreed. Manual steps:
1) patch deployment to use image gcr.redwood/release:2026.2.9
2) run quick smoke canary tests
3) if green, run deploy-bot promote stable command manually

Example command to pin: 
```bash
kubectl -n prod set image deployment/app-server app-server=gcr.redwood/release:2026.2.9 --record
```

ci-bot: CI job #7824 failed: aws s3 put-object error: 408 Request Timeout after 120s. Retries exhausted.

andrew: That 408 aligns with a transient network issue to the S3 endpoint, but the Helm decrypt is a separate error — likely KMS key alias mismatch after rotation. We should treat both.

maria: Decision for now: pin canary to 2026.2.9 and perform manual canary -> stable promotion. I'll create a rollback PR for the release branch to document the pin and the reason. @samir can you run the manual promote after smoke? @andrew please open a postmortem ticket for the CI token/key rotation and helm decrypt failures.

samir: On it. Running the smoke now. ETA ~12m. I'll post results here. :eyes:

jen: I'll update release notes to add a blurb: "Promotion temporarily pinned to 2026.2.9 due to artifact upload + secret decrypt issues; follow-up investigation in #eng-releases."

kai: If manual reupload is needed I can spawn a runner with the rotated tokens and try `ci/artifact push --no-cache` to avoid cache-leasing. Command I used before: 
```bash
./scripts/ci-push-artifact --token $CI_TOKEN --no-cache gs://redwood-artifacts/releases/2026.3.1.tar.gz
```

deploy-bot: Manual promote permitted by user. Remember to include rollout window: change-window closes in 30m.

samir: Smoke passed (basic health + 3 quick e2e permutations). Proceeding to manual promote.

samir: Manual promote ran: `deploy-bot promote --from canary --to stable --release 2026.3.1 --manual` :shipit:

deploy-bot: Promotion succeeded. stable image now gcr.redwood/release:2026.2.9. Canary remains pinned. Logs: https://ci.redwood/promote/7824/success

maria: Great — thanks all. Follow-ups: @andrew to file postmortem + rollback PR merged by me; @kai to attempt artifact reupload once keys/tokens confirmed; @jen to finish release note update. We'll keep the release marked "pinned temporary" until we confirm artifact pipeline health. :thumbsup:

andrew: Filed postmortem: https://phab.redwood/T1234 with initial checklist and ownership. Adding timeline and action items.

jen: Release notes updated and pushed to docs repo.

maria: Closing thread — monitoring for any regressions. If anyone sees an unexpected consumer error, ping me directly. Thanks! :raised_hands:
